comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Primarily a rural Alaska electric utility; telecom is secondary and much smaller than GCI's wireless and broadband focus.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Rural wireless, broadband, cable and carrier services with Alaska operations and government subsidy exposure; closely matches GCI's business.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Diversified holding company of billboards, insurance and a small broadband unit; not a telecom operator.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Business aviation inflight connectivity and avionics equipment; different customers and business from terrestrial consumer telecom.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Regional network owner selling broadband, video, voice, business data and wholesale transport; closely similar service mix, though wireline-focused.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Integrated wireline broadband, video, voice and wireless carrier in smaller markets, with towers and business services; similar operator model.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Largely wholesale fiber and infrastructure lessor; lacks GCI's wireless and integrated retail provider model.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Satellite manufacturer and defense systems provider with global mobility connectivity; different business from regional terrestrial telecom.
